bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'STK_GIT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'STK_GIT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'STK_GIT_DIRTY_COUNT='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'STK_BOT_RUNNING='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name"
printf 'STK_SHOP_URL_CONFIGURED='; if test -n "$(docker exec "$name" sh -c 'printf %s "$VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL"')";then echo YES;else echo NO;fi
printf 'STK_SHOP_LISTEN='; docker exec "$name" sh -c 'node -e "fetch(\"http://127.0.0.1:8766/health\").then(r=>process.stdout.write(String(r.status))).catch(()=>process.stdout.write(\"UNREACHABLE\"))"';echo
printf 'STK_BOT_READY='; docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' && echo PASS || echo NOT_VERIFIED
